name: ghidriff
notes: PyPI wheel ghidriff-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl (sha256 given) installed into .venv with pyghidra 3.1.0. Wrapper bin/ghidriff sets JAVA_HOME (JDK 21) and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR (Ghidra 12.1.4, read-only use). test.sh builds two self-made x86-64 ELFs where only foo() changes, diffs them headless and checks the JSON lists foo as modified and not bar. Needs clang, lld@21 and llvm@21 from Homebrew. Platforms are whatever Ghidra can analyze; only x86-64 was tested.
